name: LZR 416 450 MAX (Lazer, 450 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G7 BC, printed ".42 est". Marked est: estimated, within +/- 5% (page footnote). The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 4, Lazer - Ultra Long Range Hunting: Caliber .416, Grains 450, Minimum Required Twist *1-13", Part Number LZR 416 450 MAX, G1 BC .83* est, G7 BC .42 est, OAL 2.208", Bullet Projection 1.576"

note: G1 BC is printed ".83* est"; does not read as a value and is not stored. The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1-2 inches faster is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.576".
